verdict.rationale: Brex's AI page says assistants do employees' expenses for them: they fetch receipts and offer policy help (brex-docs-23). A review agent follows up with anyone out of compliance (brex-docs-16), and Brex AI applies spend and documentation rules to every transaction (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-15). Together these cover receipt-chasing and conversational policy guidance, though only through vendor marketing claims. Missing for 10: any evidence the assistant explains card declines, explicit evidence of answering "can I expense this?" before a purchase, detailed first-party docs on the conversational policy assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
